claims: The 2026 Boston Marathon is on April 20.
WCVB Channel 5 is the local TV channel for New England for the Boston Marathon.
ESPN2 is the national TV channel for the Boston Marathon.
Very Local Boston streams the Boston Marathon.
ESPN App streams the Boston Marathon.
The BAA Racing App streams the Boston Marathon.
The official B.A.A. Racing App can be used to track runners.
A Sensory-Friendly Zone is available near mile 13.5.
Downtown traffic is restricted during the Boston Marathon.
Street parking is limited downtown during the Boston Marathon.
Hopkinton is at miles 1-2 of the Boston Marathon course.
Ashland State Park is around miles 3-5 of the Boston Marathon course.
Natick Common is at miles 8-11 of the Boston Marathon course.
The Scream Tunnel is near Wellesley College at miles 12-16 of the Boston Marathon course.
Newton Hills are at miles 16-21 of the Boston Marathon course.
Heartbreak Hill is at miles 20-21 of the Boston Marathon course.
Beacon Street is at miles 23-25 in Brookline on the Boston Marathon course.
The finish line is near Copley Square in Boston at mile 26+ of the Boston Marathon course.
